verses.text: A psalm by David. A song for the dedication of the temple. I'll lift you up, LORD, because you lifted me up. You didn't let my enemies celebrate over me.
LORD my God, I cried out to you, and you healed me.
LORD, you pulled me up from Sheol. You kept me alive and out of the pit.
Sing your praise to the LORD, you who are faithful to him. Give thanks to his holy name.
His anger lasts a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime. Tears can stay the night, but joy shows up in the morning. 🌅
When things were going my way, I said, “Nothing's ever going to shake me.”
LORD, your favor made my mountain stand firm. Then you hid your face, and I was shaken.
I cried out to you, LORD. I pleaded with you:
“What good comes of my death if I go down to the pit? Will the dust praise you or tell people your truth?
Hear me, LORD, and show me mercy. LORD, come help me.”
You turned my mourning into dancing. You took off my clothes of grief and dressed me in joy, 💃
so my heart can sing your praise and never go quiet. LORD my God, I'll thank you forever!
